distinctFrom.reason: Referential transparency lets an expression be replaced by its value, while immutability forbids a value from changing after creation.

records.name: Referential Transparency
records.definition: A design rule that an expression can be replaced by its value without changing the program's behavior.

records.name: Pure Functions
records.definition: A technique for writing logic as functions whose result depends only on their arguments and which have no side effects.

records.name: Immutability
records.definition: A design rule that a value is never changed after it is created, and a change produces a new value.

exemplar.before:
type Foo = { name: string; tags: string[] };
function addTag(foo: Foo, tag: string) { foo.tags.push(tag); return foo; }
exemplar.after:
type Foo = Readonly<{ name: string; tags: readonly string[] }>;
function addTag(foo: Foo, tag: string): Foo { return { ...foo, tags: [...foo.tags, tag] }; }
